question:
I'm putting together a simple dashboard page for a small internal tool and need help with both the UI references and the architecture drawing.  
    Could you find a clean icon that represents a "statistics overview", show me the documentation and a couple of examples for the Ant Design Card component, and then generate a small architecture diagram that shows:  
    - a frontend module using that Card component,  
    - a backend API service,  
    - and a data storage layer?  
    Keep the diagram high-level.
answer:
All three are ready. One note up front: the icon catalog returns **name, tags, and unicode glyph data only** — no rendered preview — so my icon pick is based on the catalog's own naming and tags, not on visual inspection. ## 1. Icon for "statistics overview" **Recommended: `chart-analysis`** (Hugeicons, category `business`) Its catalog tags are exactly the concept you described: `analysis`, `chart`, `statistics`, `report`, `business`, `data`, `graph`, `trend`. - Unicode glyph: `󱤍` (decimal `989453`) - Available in all 11 styles; the codepoint is the same across styles for this icon (`bulk-rounded`, `duotone-rounded`, `solid-rounded`, `stroke-rounded`, `stroke-standard`, `solid-sharp`, `twotone-rounded`, etc.) **Solid alternates, all tagged for statistics/dashboard:** | Icon | Why it fits | |---|---| | `analytics-03` | `analytics`, `bar chart`, `statistics`, `dashboard`, `metrics` — bar chart inside a frame | | `bar-chart` | `statistics`, `metrics`, `dashboard`, `report` — plainest, most "clean" | | `chart-02` | `line graph`, `trend`, `statistics`, `growth` — better if you show time series | For a *clean, low-noise* dashboard header, I'd use `bar-chart` or `analytics-03`; for a panel that's explicitly "overview/analysis", `chart-analysis` is the most on-the-nose. Style choice: use `stroke-rounded` for a card header (matches Ant Design's line-icon look), `duotone-rounded` if you want the icon to carry a little accent color. ## 2. Ant Design `Card` — documentation **When to use:** the most basic card container; holds text, lists, images, paragraphs. Ant Design explicitly calls this out as common on **background/overview pages (后台概览页面)** — which is your case. Core API: ```jsx 卡片内容 ``` | Prop | Description | Type | Default | Version | |---|---|---|---|---| | `title` | Card title | ReactNode | – | | | `extra` | Action area at top-right | ReactNode | – | | | `actions` | Action group at card bottom | Array\ | – | | | `cover` | Card cover | ReactNode | – | | | `hoverable` | Lift on hover | boolean | `false` | | | `loading` | Show skeleton placeholder while loading | boolean | `false` | | | `size` | Card size | `default` \| `small` | `default` | | | `variant` | Visual variant | `outlined` \| `borderless` | `outlined` | **5.24.0** | | `~~bordered~~` | **Deprecated** — use `variant` instead | boolean | `true` | | | `tabList` / `activeTabKey` / `onTabChange` | Tabs inside the card | TabItemType[] / string / (key) => void | – | | | `classNames` / `styles` | Semantic-DOM styling (object or function form) | Record\ | – | | Sub-components: **`Card.Grid`** (`hoverable`, default `true`) and **`Card.Meta`** (`avatar`, `title`, `description`). ⚠️ Two version notes: `variant` needs **antd ≥ 5.24.0**, and `bordered` is deprecated in its favor. ## 3. Two Card examples **A. Typical card with title, extra action, and bottom actions** — good for a single stat panel: ```tsx import React from 'react'; import { Card, Space } from 'antd'; import { EllipsisOutlined, ReloadOutlined } from '@ant-design/icons'; const StatsCard: React.FC = () => ( Details} actions={[, ]} style={{ width: 300 }} >

Active users: 1,284

Requests today: 32,910

 ); export default StatsCard; ``` **B. Grid cards in a `Row`/`Col`** — Ant Design's own "often paired with a grid on system overview pages" pattern, i.e. your dashboard layout: ```tsx import React from 'react'; import { Card, Col, Row } from 'antd'; const DashboardGrid: React.FC = () => ( 32,910 184 ms 0.12 % ); export default DashboardGrid; ``` Also worth knowing for a live dashboard: `` renders a skeleton, so you get a loading state for free while the API call resolves. ## 4. Architecture diagram ![High-level architecture diagram: Dashboard UI (Ant Design Cards) to API Service to Data Storage](https://www.plantuml.com/plantuml/svg/LP0nJyD038Nt-nLM9XWYTWRKXZHg42gL4YPWS1CdEVNYg-wSLWZntt40YR3Pxtr-jhoAWa6cqHcnuWXA5WgC3chl7QImjVsGFjAP7An3CrYXHgP0niIZvHC67A7nuyapiLJohWb12UJUqGA90xR-Ohc73brSEYrrE3afFCiEHu8AELOKR6VC2PiZzWH94TGbRXFuC00lESRXu36qy5o-yjMQ1NAAjcUuLp5Ulm56A3RcSn6HQV6NiDwNe4lEjg5lMFj_T8w2FsYhrG7ZhmQL-A14CW_bsJnJR21Dx-O4k8LjNU_X1XwgfvsPbTd9CpK2OQl69UZ_p4eFqOT_0G00) Source, if you want to tweak it: ```plantuml @startuml title Internal Tool - High-Level Architecture skinparam componentStyle rectangle skinparam shadowing false skinparam defaultFontName SansSerif package "Frontend" { [Dashboard UI\n(Ant Design Cards)] as FE } package "Backend" { [API Service] as API } package "Data" { database "Data Storage" as DB } FE --> API : HTTP / JSON API --> DB : read / write @enduml ``` Three boxes, two edges, grouped by tier — deliberately no internal detail. The Card component is named inside the frontend module so the diagram ties back to the UI reference above. Two honest caveats: this returns a **hosted PlantUML SVG URL**, not a saved local file — download it if you need it checked in. And if your diagram needs to live in the repo, tell me where and I'll wire up the file step separately.

Card 组件的文档：
## 何时使用
最基础的卡片容器，可承载文字、列表、图片、段落，常用于后台概览页面。
## API
```jsx
<Card title="卡片标题">卡片内容</Card>
```
| 参数 | 说明 | 类型 | 默认值 | 版本 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| actions | 卡片操作组，位置在卡片底部 | Array<ReactNode> | - |  |
| activeTabKey | 当前激活页签的 key | string | - |  |
| ~~bordered~~ | 是否有边框, 请使用 `variant` 替换 | boolean | true |  |
| variant | 形态变体 | `outlined` \| `borderless` \| | `outlined` | 5.24.0 |
| classNames | 用于自定义组件内部各语义化结构的 class，支持对象或函数 | Record<[SemanticDOM](#semantic-dom), string> \| (info: { props })=> Record<[SemanticDOM](#semantic-dom), string> | - |  |
| cover | 卡片封面 | ReactNode | - |  |
| defaultActiveTabKey | 初始化选中页签的 key，如果没有设置 activeTabKey | string | `第一个页签的 key` |  |
| extra | 卡片右上角的操作区域 | ReactNode | - |  |
| hoverable | 鼠标移过时可浮起 | boolean | false |  |
| loading | 当卡片内容还在加载中时，可以用 loading 展示一个占位 | boolean | false |  |
| size | card 的尺寸 | `default` \| `small` | `default` |  |
| tabBarExtraContent | tab bar 上额外的元素 | ReactNode | - |  |
| tabList | 页签标题列表 | [TabItemType](/components/tabs-cn#tabitemtype)[] | - |  |
| tabProps | [Tabs](/components/tabs-cn#tabs) | - | - |  |
| title | 卡片标题 | ReactNode | - |  |
| type | 卡片类型，可设置为 `inner` 或 不设置 | string | - |  |
| styles | 用于自定义组件内部各语义化结构的行内 style，支持对象或函数 | Record<[SemanticDOM](#semantic-dom), CSSProperties> \| (info: { props })=> Record<[SemanticDOM](#semantic-dom), CSSProperties> | - |  |
| onTabChange | 页签切换的回调 | (key) => void | - |  |
### Card.Grid
| 参数      | 说明                   | 类型          | 默认值 | 版本 |
| --------- | ---------------------- | ------------- | ------ | ---- |
| className | 网格容器类名           | string        | -      |      |
| hoverable | 鼠标移过时可浮起       | boolean       | true   |      |
| style     | 定义网格容器类名的样式 | CSSProperties | -      |      |
### Card.Meta
| 参数        | 说明               | 类型          | 默认值 | 版本 |
| ----------- | ------------------ | ------------- | ------ | ---- |
| avatar      | 头像/图标          | ReactNode     | -      |      |
| className   | 容器类名           | string        | -      |      |
| description | 描述内容           | ReactNode     | -      |      |
| style       | 定义容器类名的样式 | CSSProperties | -      |      |
| title       | 标题内容           | ReactNode     | -      |      |

如有版本说明需要提醒用户需要使用某个版本及以上的版本
